title: Add gateway hardening limits (config.yaml + optional main.ts body-parser patch)

maxBodyBytes.description: gateway.maxBodyBytes — non-multipart body limit (e.g. '5mb'). Also drives the main.ts patch.

uploadMaxFiles.description: gateway.upload.maxFiles — max files per multipart request.

patchMain.description: Also patch main.ts to re-register the body parsers with maxBodyBytes.
